const body = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;

// Map frontend kit payload to patients table columns
const mappedData = {
  user_id: body.user_id,
  submission_key: body.submission_key,
  full_name: body.fullName || body.name,
  date_of_birth: body.dob,
  gender: body.sex || body.gender,
  blood_type: body.bloodType,
  genotype: body.genotype,

  // Arrays
  conditions: body.conditionsList || [],
  surgeries: body.surgeriesList || [],
  drug_allergies: body.drugAllergies || [],
  food_allergies: body.foodAllergies || [],
  rx_meds: body.rxMeds || [],
  otc_meds: body.otcMeds || [],
  herbal_meds: body.herbalMeds || [],
  immunisations: body.vaccines || [],
  mental_history: body.mentalHistory || [],
  cognitive: body.cognitive || [],
  directives: body.directives || [],
  fam_history: body.familyHistory || [],
  assistive: body.assistive || [],
  substance_use: body.substanceUse || [],
  pets_type: body.petsType || [],

  // Strings / Enums
  cond_other: body.conditionsOther || '',
  surg_other: body.surgeriesOther || '',
  meds_notes: body.medsNotes || '',
  admit: body.admit || '',
  admit_details: body.admitDetails || '',
  transfusion: body.transfusion || '',
  transfusion_details: body.transfusionDetails || '',
  imm_notes: body.vaccineNotes || '',
  mental_current: body.mentalCurrent || '',
  mental_notes: body.mentalNotes || '',
  dir_notes: body.dirNotes || '',
  fam_history_notes: body.famHistoryNotes || '',
  assistive_notes: body.assistiveNotes || '',
  smoking: body.smoking || '',
  alcohol: body.alcohol || '',
  substance_details: body.substanceDetails || '',
  diet: body.diet || '',
  exercise_freq: body.exerciseFreq || '',
  occupation_cat: body.occupationCat || '',
  living_situation: body.livingSituation || '',
  pets: body.pets || '',
  lifestyle_notes: body.lifestyleNotes || '',
  obgyn_notes: body.gynComplaints || '',
  pregnancy_complications: body.pregnancyComplications || []
};

// Strip empty strings and empty arrays to let DB defaults handle it (or preserve existing data if upserting)
const cleanData = {};
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(mappedData)) {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    if (v.length > 0) cleanData[k] = v;
  } else if (v !== '' && v !== null && v !== undefined) {
    cleanData[k] = v;
  }
}

return [{ json: cleanData }];
